item.title: Meet Microsoft Scout, Your AI Coworker That Never Logs Off
item.description: Microsoft’s OpenClaw-style agent appears in Teams, just like a human colleague, and automates your dull office tasks.

item.title: Flush With Cash From OpenAI, Opal Is Making an AI-Powered Audio Gadget
item.description: Opal, the company famous for making a fancy webcam, has pivoted to making other consumer electronics. Fueled by big investments from OpenAI and Samsung, it’s working on an audio gadget first.

item.title: The Trump Administration Is at War With Itself Over AI Regulation
item.description: Donald Trump killed an executive order to regulate AI. Now, administration officials and AI executives are trying to figure out if there’s anything left to piece back together.

item.title: Anthropic Confidentially Files for What Could Be the Largest IPO Ever
item.description: The AI giant behind Claude submitted paperwork on Monday that would take it public, just a couple of weeks after SpaceX’s splashy IPO announcement.

item.title: Norse Atlantic Airways Offers Dirt-Cheap Tickets. There’s a Catch
item.description: Dozens of people have complained to the Federal Trade Commission about Norse Atlantic Airways’ tech-first customer service operation. Some said they lost thousands of dollars.

item.title: How Turkey Hacked the Hair Transplant Industry
item.description: From specialized motors to the use of machine learning algorithms, Turkey’s billion-dollar hair-transplant industry is the result of a constant process of innovation.

item.title: Do You Actually Need to Pay for Transcription Software?
item.description: I tested Wispr Flow and various AI-powered transcription software to see whether you should bother subscribing or stick with free services.

item.title: Amazon Is Making an AI-Animated ‘Good Advice Cupcake’ TV Show. Its Original Creator Is Furious
item.description: Loryn Brantz created The Good Advice Cupcake for BuzzFeed years ago. The company licensed the character for a new Amazon series—made with AI—without her consent.

item.title: Hands-On With Gemini Spark: I Gave It Access to My Life and It Friend-Zoned My Boyfriend
item.description: Google’s new AI agent combed through my emails, documents, and calendar to plan a birthday party and still didn’t clock the person most important to me.

item.title: We Asked the ‘Future of Truth’ Author to Explain How He Used AI. It Didn’t Go Well
item.description: A book about how AI shapes perceptions of reality came under fire for using AI-generated quotes. Its problems go beyond that.
